name: The Headless Horseman
note: Polygons in the rest pose (A1) pixels. Gothic sheets (his own character sheet is the style image). Transylvania's seat 4, drawn facing right and mirrored. The master is the rest pose's OWN pumpkin. Every pose but rest a whole-figure frame with its own drawn pumpkin. No prop: the candle's light is the tell surface.

what.A1: Rest: gauntlets on the table's edge, apart, the pumpkin on his collar, candle steady
what.A3: Check: a gauntleted finger taps the felt
what.A4: Call: right gauntlet pushes forward along the felt
what.A5: Bet: leans in, right gauntlet pushed well forward
what.A6: Fold: a curt flick of the right gauntlet
what.B1: All in: both gauntlets push forward together
what.B2: Show: right gauntlet turns palm up
what.B3: Big win: both gauntlets raised high (`win_big`)
what.B4: The candle in his pumpkin burns brighter
what.B5: Settles the pumpkin on his collar (decoy for B4)
what.B6: Drums a gauntlet on the table
what.C1: His sword rattles in its scabbard (decoy for B6)
what.C2: The flame in his pumpkin gutters
what.C3: A smell of cold leaves drifts from him (decoy for C2)
what.C4: Turns his whole body to look at you
what.C5: Draws his cloak about his shoulders
what.C6: Sits very still, the pumpkin tilted a little toward the pot
what.D1: Talking: one gauntlet raised, palm open
what.D2: Facing a big bet: leaning back, gauntlets flat
what.D3: Lost a pot: shoulders slump, the light dims
what.D4: Crushing loss: a gauntlet slammed flat, the pumpkin bowed (`lose_big`)
what.D5: Heads up: leaning in on both forearms
what.D6: A slow, grave nod to the table

rest.what: his right forearm and steel gauntlet
his left forearm and steel gauntlet
